findings.summary: Javelin Advisors LLC formed 11/13/2024 in Delaware. Three equal co-owners: George A. Sorial (Managing Director), Keith Schiller (Managing Director), Robert W. Seiden (Managing Director). Primary address 433 Plaza Real Suite 275 Boca Raton FL 33432 at registration; changed to 1701 Pennsylvania Ave NW Suite 200 DC 20006 by Nov 2025. Additional address in engagement letter: 1751 Pinnacle Drive Tysons VA 22102. Website: www.javelinadvisorsllc.com. FARA Reg #7579.

Pakistan FARA engagement financial details. Contract signed 04/24/2025 between Javelin and Seiden Law LLP for benefit of Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Fee $50K/month. Payments routed through Seiden Law LLP as intermediary. Documented payments: 4x $50K from Seiden Law LLP (05/07, 05/28, 06/30, 08/20/2025) = $200K total received. FARA terminated 10/08/2025. Disbursements for Pakistan work: $28,459.79 (FARA registration, hotel, travel, legal fees, transport/food for two DC trips). Pakistan contact at Embassy: Rizwan Saeed Sheikh.

FARA Supplemental (period ending 10/31/2025): Pakistan activities included strategic/advisory services to establish long-term US economic partnerships; facilitated representation of Pakistan on Pakistan-India conflict and development of critical minerals. Political activities confirmed. Informational materials disseminated to public officials and legislators via email. Contacts during Operation Sindoor included offices of Senate Majority Leader John Thune, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries. FARA relationship terminated 10/08/2025 per supplemental. Supplemental signed by Andrew J. Astuno, Counsel, Seiden Law LLP on behalf of Javelin.

Javelin Advisors full LDA lobbying client roster reveals far broader access-brokering operation than Pakistan alone. Confirmed clients: (1) Capstone USA Advisory Group LLC (NY) - Ukraine reconstruction, registered Dec 2024, Q3 income $300K, Q4 active; (2) Fred Daibes (NJ, conv. Menendez co-conspirator) - executive pardon/relief, registered Q1 2025, income $1M (reported externally); (3) Logical Strategies LLC (NY) - EPA asbestos rule + govt contracts, registered Q3 2025, Q3 income $1.2M (largest single payment); (4) Greg E. Lindberg (NC, conv. $2B fraud/bribery) - executive pardon, registered Q3 2025, minimal fees; (5) NioCorp Developments Ltd (CO) - critical minerals funding/contracts, registered Q4 2025, Q4 income $400K; (6) I-MEI Foods Co Ltd (Taiwan) - food/cybersecurity/robotics govt contracts, registered Q4 2025. Third lobbyist on multiple filings: Robert Seiden.

Javelin Advisors played a key role in the US-China rare earth agreement of October 30, 2025, per reporting from January 2026. The US-China deal: China agreed to pause sweeping controls on rare-earth magnets in exchange for US rolling back expansion of curbs on Chinese companies. This was reported alongside Javelin's Pakistan minerals work, suggesting Javelin was operating across multiple rare earth supply-chain diplomatic tracks simultaneously.

Pakistan rare earth deal advanced materially after Javelin engagement. Key milestones: (1) Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum April 2025 (while Javelin engaged); (2) FWO-USSM (US Strategic Metals, Missouri) $500M MOU signed 09/08/2025 at PM's House Islamabad; (3) First shipment of rare earths to USSM dispatched ~10/02/2025 containing antimony, copper concentrate, neodymium, praseodymium; (4) Three-phase plan: Phase 1 2025-2026 export raw minerals; Phase 2 2026-2028 refineries in Pakistan; Phase 3 2028+ large-scale mining. FWO (Frontier Works Organization) is Pakistan Army engineering corps. Balochistan is geographic focus (also site of Reko Diq copper-gold mega-project). US Deputy Asst Secretary John Mark Pommersheim visited Islamabad for expanded cooperation framework. Javelin FARA terminated same month as FWO-USSM MOU (Oct 2025).

Political contributions disclosed in FARA supplemental (period ending 10/31/2025): (1) 09/08/2025: Keith Schiller AND George Sorial jointly donated $5,000 to Sen. Katie Britt (R-AL) via TEAM KATIE joint fundraising committee, credit card; (2) 09/08/2025: Keith Schiller separately donated $5,000 to Sen. Katie Britt; (3) 10/28/2025: $4,000 donation to Rep. Ronny Jackson (R-TX) by check. Sen. Britt sits on Senate Foreign Relations Committee and Banking Committee. Rep. Jackson sits on House Armed Services Committee (relevant to critical minerals/defense). These are disclosed as lobbyist political contributions during active FARA representation period.

Seiden Law LLP structure creates triangular relationship: Seiden Law held the underlying contract with Government of Pakistan; Javelin was subcontractor to Seiden Law. Payments flowed Pakistan govt -> Seiden Law LLP -> Javelin Advisors LLC. This means Seiden Law LLP held the direct FARA-reportable relationship with Pakistan. Robert W. Seiden simultaneously is (1) Managing Partner of Seiden Law LLP (the law firm contracting with Pakistan); (2) equal co-owner/Managing Director of Javelin Advisors (the subcontractor receiving fees); (3) listed lobbyist on multiple LDA filings. This creates a potential self-dealing arrangement where Seiden controls both sides of the contract.

Javelin Advisors lobbied for two convicted felons pursuing executive pardons: (1) Fred Daibes (NJ businessman, convicted of bribing Sen. Bob Menendez with cash and gold bars, serving 7-year sentence): hired Javelin for 'executive relief' (pardon), registered Q1 2025, paid $1M per external reporting, engagement with Javelin ended June 2025; (2) Greg E. Lindberg (NC billionaire, pleaded guilty 2024 to $2B fraud/money laundering, earlier jury conviction for bribery of NC Insurance Commissioner): hired Javelin Q3 2025 for 'executive pardon,' minimal fees. Combined, these engagements represent Javelin operating as a pardon-brokering service alongside its foreign lobbying work.

Javelin registered LDA lobbyist for I-MEI Foods Co Ltd (Taiwan) Q4 2025. LDA discloses three affiliated foreign entities tied to I-MEI: Tansimo Robotic Manufacturing Inc (Taiwan), Chelpis Quantum Corp (Taiwan, quantum cybersecurity), Golden Saddle Machinery Co Ltd (Taiwan). Issue areas: Defense and Government Issues - government contracts for food products, cybersecurity and/or robotics. I-MEI CEO Luis Ko previously invested in Chelpis Quantum 2022. This represents a Taiwan-origin client cluster pursuing US defense/government contracts through Trump insider access.

Logical Strategies LLC (NY) was Javelin's single largest paying client: $1.2M income in Q3 2025. Issue: EPA Final Rule Asbestos Part 1 (chrysotile asbestos, Toxic Substances Control Act) and government contracts. This is significant because the EPA asbestos rule is an active Trumpian deregulation battleground - the Trump EPA has been rolling back Biden-era asbestos restrictions. Identity of Logical Strategies beneficial owners not established. The name 'Logical Strategies' does not match any prominent publicly known entity - possible front/shell or quiet operator. Q4 2025: no activity reported from same client.

Javelin Advisors consolidated revenue estimate from LDA filings: (1) Capstone USA (Ukraine) Q3 2025: $300K; Q4: no income reported; (2) Fred Daibes (pardon) Q1 2025: $1M reported externally (LDA filed no income but external NBC reported $1M); (3) Logical Strategies (asbestos EPA) Q3 2025: $1.2M; Q4: none; (4) Greg Lindberg (pardon) Q3-Q4: minimal/none; (5) NioCorp (minerals) Q4 2025: $400K; (6) I-MEI Foods (Taiwan) Q4 2025: newly registered. Pakistan FARA separately: $200K. OpenSecrets total 2025: $2.5M. These figures suggest Javelin billed at least $3.5-4M in its first full year.

FARA Exhibit B Amendment filed 05/09/2025 (same day as Operation Sindoor military escalation): Javelin expanded Pakistan engagement scope to explicitly include Jammu and Kashmir dispute and Pakistan-India relations. Amendment text states 'proposed activities are to be updated to include ensuring that Pakistan's perspectives on important regional and global issues (Jammu and Kashmir dispute) and Pakistan-India relations are effectively communicated to the US Executive Branch, US Congress, and the public.' This amendment was filed the same week India launched Operation Sindoor airstrikes against Pakistan (May 6-7, 2025). Signed by Keith Schiller and George Sorial 05/09/2025.

Javelin Advisors LLC (FARA #7579) registered as foreign agent on 04/25/2025 representing the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. Registered address: 433 Plaza Real Suite 275, Boca Raton FL 33432. Foreign principal address: 3517 International Court NW Washington DC 20008 (Pakistan Embassy). Registration terminated 10/08/2025. Registrants: George A. Sorial and Keith Schiller (short-form filers).

Pakistan paid Javelin Advisors ,000/month as a subcontractor to Seiden Law LLP. Seiden Law received ,000/month directly from Pakistan, subcontracted Javelin at K/month. Total Pakistan lobbying spend was ,000/month across two firms (Squire Patton Boggs ,500 + Seiden/Javelin). Javelin agreement dated April 24, 2025. Services: promote exploration and sale of rare earth/critical minerals, establish US economic partnerships.

Robert Seiden (private investigator formerly associated with Trump) is co-lobbyist with Sorial and Schiller at Javelin Advisors LLC. Seiden appears as lobbyist in LDA filings for clients: Fred Daibes (executive relief), Logical Strategies LLC (asbestos/EPA), Greg Lindberg (executive pardon), I-MEI Foods (Taiwan - defense contracts), NioCorp Developments (critical minerals/DOD), Capstone USA Advisory Group (Ukraine reconstruction). Seiden Law LLP is the prime contractor for Pakistan FARA engagement.

Javelin Advisors LLC LDA lobbying client roster and disclosed income 2024-2025: (1) Capstone USA Advisory Group LLC (Ukraine reconstruction defense/gov relations, registered 2024, 2025 Q3 income ,000); (2) Fred Daibes NJ individual (executive relief/pardon, Q1 2025 income ,000,000); (3) Logical Strategies LLC (asbestos EPA regulation + government contracts, Q3 2025 income ,200,000); (4) Greg E. Lindberg NC individual (executive pardon, Q3 2025 income <,000); (5) NioCorp Developments Ltd (critical minerals DOD funding/contracts, Q4 2025 income ,000); (6) I-MEI Foods Co. Ltd (Taiwan - food/cybersecurity/robotics DOD contracts, registration only). Total disclosed LDA income: approximately .9M+.

EDGAR full-text search confirms Javelin Advisors LLC and George Sorial are completely absent from SEC filings database. Zero hits for Javelin Advisors (exact phrase) and zero hits for George Sorial (exact phrase). This corroborates the existing finding that GreenMet/Sorial/Schiller are absent from all 167 CRML SEC filings. The GreenMet-Critical Metals partnership and compensation structure, if any, is entirely undisclosed in public SEC filings.

FARA filings document Javelin Advisors' contacts with US government officials on behalf of Pakistan. Ronny Jackson (Rep TX-13, former Trump White House physician) was primary congressional contact. May 1 2025: in-person meeting with Pakistani officials. May 6: phone call re India-Pakistan conflict. May 16: dinner arrangement call. May 28: critical call leading to draft MoU delivery via email. Other targets: Rep. Dan Renshaw and Rep. Morgan Luttrell (both TX Navy veterans). Javelin also delivered a proposed bilateral MoU on rare earths to Ryan Zinke's office. MoU later led to M deal between US Strategic Metals and Pakistan's Frontier Works Organisation (September 2025).

Javelin Advisors LLC (co-founded by George Sorial and Keith Schiller, both former GreenMet shareholders) received $400,000 from NioCorp Developments Ltd. in Q4 2025, disclosed on LDA Senate filings. Lobbying was for 'funding and/or contracts with respect to NioCorp.' Javelin also registered under FARA for Islamic Republic of Pakistan (April-October 2025), generating at least $1M from Fred Daibes and $1.2M from Logical Strategies LLC. Total disclosed Javelin revenue in 2025: approximately $3.4M.

Javelin Advisors LLC (Boca Raton FL address: 433 Plaza Real, Ste 275) registered under FARA (Reg No. 7579) on April 25, 2025 as agent for the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. FARA registration was terminated October 8, 2025. This means Javelin Advisors — founded by former GreenMet shareholders George Sorial and Keith Schiller — was a registered foreign agent for Pakistan while simultaneously lobbying for NioCorp Developments Ltd. (critical minerals/US defense) and Capstone USA Advisory Group LLC.

Javelin Advisors (Sorial/Schiller/Seiden) represented 6 clients in 2025 for $3.4M total. Beyond Logical Strategies ($1.2M, EPA asbestos/chrysotile), clients included: Fred Daibes ($1M Q1, executive relief — pardon lobbying), Greg Lindberg (executive pardon), Capstone USA Advisory Group ($300K, Ukrainian private business technology/defense), NioCorp Developments Ltd ($400K Q4, critical minerals/government contracts), I-Mei Foods Co Ltd of Taiwan (defense/food/cybersecurity). The Logical Strategies EPA asbestos mandate was Javelin's single highest-issue payment in Q3 2025.

curation.lead:
Javelin Advisors LLC is a Washington-based lobbying and advisory firm formed in Delaware on November 13, 2024, by three co-equal managing directors: George Sorial, a former Trump Organization executive vice president; Keith Schiller, Donald Trump's longtime personal bodyguard and Director of Oval Office Operations; and Robert W. Seiden, a private investigator and attorney whose law firm, Seiden Law LLP, serves as both contracting intermediary and co-lobbyist [Finding #6285]. The firm markets itself with the tagline "Founded by Insiders. Defined by Access" [Finding #6157].

In its first full year, Javelin registered under both the Foreign Agents Registration Act (representing the Islamic Republic of Pakistan from April to October 2025) and the Lobbying Disclosure Act (representing six domestic and foreign-linked clients), generating an estimated $3.4 million in disclosed revenue [Finding #6306]. Its client portfolio spans foreign government representation, critical minerals diplomacy, executive pardon brokering, environmental deregulation lobbying, Ukraine reconstruction advisory work, and Taiwanese defense-sector market entry -- a breadth that reveals the firm's core function as a political access monetization vehicle for Trump-era insiders [Finding #6292].

All three founders share prior equity in GreenMet, a critical minerals consultancy co-founded by Drew Horn, linking Javelin to a broader network that positions former government officials as intermediaries across the global rare earth supply chain [Finding #6369].
curation.system_role: Javelin Advisors LLC functions as an access-brokering firm that converts the personal proximity of Trump-era insiders into lobbying revenue across foreign governments, convicted felons seeking pardons, and corporate clients pursuing government contracts -- operating simultaneously under FARA and LDA regimes with a triangular contracting structure that obscures the flow of funds.

sections.title: Founders and Corporate Structure
sections.content:
Javelin Advisors LLC was incorporated in Delaware on November 13, 2024, with three equal co-owners serving as managing directors: George Sorial, Keith Schiller, and Robert W. Seiden [Finding #6285]. Sorial served as executive vice president and counsel at the Trump Organization from 2002 to 2019, managing its global portfolio and serving as chief compliance counsel from 2017 onward [Finding #6300]. Schiller was Trump's personal security chief for decades and held the title Director of Oval Office Operations during the first Trump administration [Finding #6157]. Seiden operates Seiden Law LLP, which functions as both a legal intermediary for Javelin's foreign engagements and as the firm through which payments from foreign principals are routed [Finding #6299].

The firm's registered address shifted from 433 Plaza Real, Suite 275, Boca Raton, Florida at formation to 1701 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Suite 200, Washington, D.C., by November 2025, with an additional address at 1751 Pinnacle Drive, Tysons, Virginia [Finding #6285]. All three founders hold prior equity stakes in GreenMet, a critical minerals consultancy co-founded by Drew Horn, linking Javelin to the broader GreenMet network that includes partnerships with Critical Metals Corp in Greenland [Finding #6369].

The Seiden Law intermediary arrangement is structurally significant. In the Pakistan engagement, Seiden Law LLP held the direct FARA-reportable contract with the government of Pakistan, while Javelin served as subcontractor [Finding #6299]. Because Robert Seiden simultaneously serves as managing partner of Seiden Law LLP, co-owner of Javelin, and listed lobbyist on multiple LDA filings, he controls both sides of the contracting relationship -- a configuration that raises self-dealing questions [Finding #6299].

sections.title: Pakistan: FARA Registration and Critical Minerals Diplomacy
sections.content:
Javelin registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA #7579) on April 25, 2025, as an agent for the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, with the Pakistan Embassy at 3517 International Court NW, Washington, D.C., listed as the foreign principal [Finding #6315]. The contract, signed April 24, 2025, specified a fee of $50,000 per month, with payments flowing from Pakistan through Seiden Law LLP to Javelin [Finding #6286]. Over the engagement's duration, Javelin received four payments totaling $200,000 [Finding #6286]. The engagement was terminated on October 8, 2025 [Finding #6315].

The stated purpose was to promote the exploration and sale of rare earth and critical minerals and to establish long-term US-Pakistan economic partnerships [Finding #6319]. FARA filings reference a May 2025 framework for bilateral cooperation with an indicative value characterized as up to $1 trillion, with Pakistan's Frontier Works Organization (a military engineering corps) nominated as the extraction entity [Finding #6202]. Javelin delivered a proposed bilateral memorandum of understanding on rare earths to the office of Rep. Ryan Zinke, and its primary congressional contact was Rep. Ronny Jackson (TX-13), a former Trump White House physician [Finding #6336]. Additional documented contacts included representatives Dan Renshaw and Morgan Luttrell [Finding #6336].

Pakistan's rare earth deal advanced materially during Javelin's engagement period. A $500 million MOU between the Frontier Works Organization and US Strategic Metals (Missouri) was signed on September 8, 2025, at the Prime Minister's House in Islamabad, and the first shipment of rare earths -- containing antimony, copper concentrate, neodymium, and praseodymium -- was dispatched approximately October 2, 2025 [Finding #6297]. Javelin's FARA registration was terminated the same month [Finding #6297].

On May 9, 2025 -- two days after India launched Operation Sindoor airstrikes against Pakistan -- Javelin filed a FARA Exhibit B amendment expanding its scope to include the Jammu and Kashmir dispute and Pakistan-India relations [Finding #6314]. During the Operation Sindoor crisis, Javelin disseminated informational materials to the offices of Senate Majority Leader John Thune, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries [Finding #6289].

sections.title: Domestic Lobbying Portfolio
sections.content:
Beyond its FARA-registered Pakistan work, Javelin maintained a six-client LDA lobbying roster that generated approximately $2.9 million in disclosed income during 2025 [Finding #6325]. The client mix reveals distinct categories of access-seeking behavior.

The largest single payment came from Logical Strategies LLC, a New York entity that paid $1.2 million in Q3 2025 for lobbying on the EPA's Final Rule on chrysotile asbestos under the Toxic Substances Control Act [Finding #6304]. The identity of Logical Strategies' beneficial owners has not been established, and the entity name does not match any prominent publicly known organization [Finding #6304]. Lobbying ceased after Q3 2025, coinciding with the EPA's withdrawal of its reconsideration motion in July 2025 [Finding #6384]. NioCorp Developments Ltd., a Colorado-based critical minerals company, paid $400,000 in Q4 2025 for lobbying on DOD funding and contracts [Finding #6369]. Capstone USA Advisory Group LLC, focused on Ukraine reconstruction and defense, paid $300,000 in Q3 2025 [Finding #6292].

The Taiwanese cluster represents a distinct category: I-MEI Foods Co. Ltd. registered with Javelin in Q4 2025, with LDA filings disclosing three affiliated foreign entities -- Tansimo Robotic Manufacturing Inc., Chelpis Quantum Corp (quantum cybersecurity), and Golden Saddle Machinery Co. Ltd. -- all pursuing US Department of Defense contracts for food products, cybersecurity, and robotics [Finding #6302]. This represents a Taiwan-origin corporate cluster seeking US defense market entry through Trump-insider access [Finding #6302].

sections.title: Executive Pardon Brokering
sections.content:
Two of Javelin's six LDA clients were convicted felons seeking executive pardons, a pattern that places pardon brokering alongside foreign lobbying and government contracting as a core revenue stream [Finding #6301]. Fred Daibes, a New Jersey businessman convicted of bribing Senator Bob Menendez with cash and gold bars and serving a seven-year sentence, hired Javelin in Q1 2025 for "executive relief," paying $1 million according to external reporting; the engagement ended in June 2025 [Finding #6301]. Greg E. Lindberg, a North Carolina billionaire who pleaded guilty in 2024 to $2 billion in fraud and money laundering (with a prior jury conviction for bribing the North Carolina Insurance Commissioner), retained Javelin in Q3 2025 explicitly for "executive pardon" services, paying minimal fees [Finding #6301].

The juxtaposition of these engagements with Javelin's foreign government representation and critical minerals work suggests the firm's business model rests on a single premise: that its founders' personal relationships with the sitting president can be deployed across any domain where executive authority is relevant. The pardon clients paid for proximity to clemency decisions; the foreign clients paid for proximity to trade and diplomatic decisions. The access being sold is the same in both cases [Finding #6292].

sections.title: Political Contributions and Congressional Access
sections.content:
FARA supplemental filings document political contributions made by Javelin principals during their active foreign agent registration period [Finding #6298]. On September 8, 2025, Keith Schiller and George Sorial jointly donated $5,000 to Senator Katie Britt (R-AL) through the TEAM KATIE joint fundraising committee, with Schiller making an additional separate $5,000 donation to Britt the same day [Finding #6298]. On October 28, 2025, a $4,000 donation was made to Rep. Ronny Jackson (R-TX) by check [Finding #6298].

The recipients are structurally significant. Senator Britt sits on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee and the Banking Committee, both relevant to Javelin's foreign engagement and minerals trade work [Finding #6298]. Rep. Jackson, who received both donations and lobbying contacts, sits on the House Armed Services Committee, which has jurisdiction over critical minerals defense supply chains [Finding #6298]. Jackson was also Javelin's primary congressional contact for the Pakistan engagement, with documented in-person meetings, phone calls during the India-Pakistan crisis, and a dinner arrangement during the May-June 2025 period [Finding #6336]. The convergence of lobbying contacts and campaign contributions directed at the same legislators during an active FARA registration period reveals how access and financial influence operate in tandem.

sections.title: Critical Minerals Network and GreenMet Nexus
sections.content:
Javelin's Pakistan engagement cannot be understood in isolation from its founders' involvement with GreenMet, the critical minerals consultancy whose shareholders include Sorial and Schiller alongside co-founder Drew Horn [Finding #6210]. Horn's career trajectory -- from DOE International Affairs Chief of Staff (where he helped create US critical minerals strategy) to ODNI Senior Advisor to GreenMet founder -- exemplifies a policy-to-profit pipeline in which former government officials monetize the strategies they helped design [Finding #6210]. GreenMet's partnerships span Greenland (via Tanbreez and Critical Metals Corp), Pakistan (via Javelin's FARA engagement), and Ukraine (via Capstone USA Advisory Group) [Finding #6210].

Notably, despite GreenMet's partnership with Critical Metals Corp (CRML), neither Javelin Advisors nor George Sorial appears in any of the 167 SEC filings associated with CRML [Finding #6326]. This absence suggests the GreenMet-Critical Metals relationship and any associated compensation structure is entirely undisclosed in public securities filings [Finding #6326]. Javelin was also reported to have played a role in the US-China rare earth agreement of October 30, 2025, in which China paused controls on rare-earth magnets in exchange for US rollback of curbs on Chinese companies [Finding #6295]. If accurate, this would mean Javelin was operating across at least three rare earth supply-chain diplomatic tracks simultaneously: Pakistan, Greenland (via GreenMet), and US-China negotiations [Finding #6295].

open_questions: Who are the beneficial owners of Logical Strategies LLC, Javelin's largest single client at $1.2 million, and what is the entity's connection to chrysotile asbestos industry interests?
What compensation or equity arrangements, if any, exist between Javelin's founders and Critical Metals Corp or GreenMet that are not disclosed in SEC filings?

Did Javelin's simultaneous representation of Pakistan (a foreign government under FARA) and NioCorp/Capstone (domestic clients seeking DOD contracts) create any conflict-of-interest issues under lobbying ethics rules?
What was the specific outcome of the Daibes and Lindberg pardon efforts -- were clemency petitions actually filed, and did any executive action result?
What is the full scope of Javelin's role, if any, in the October 2025 US-China rare earth agreement, given that the reported involvement rests on a single social media source?
